text:
mike_chen: Heads-up: planning SDK v22 cutover tomorrow 2026-03-18 14:00 PT. Region staged rollout: us-west -> us-east -> eu-west. Canary 1% of traffic per region for 15m, then 10% 30m, then 100%. Need owners for canary watch and rollback sign-off.
priya_r: I can own us-west canary watch. What are the smoke checks?
mike_chen: Great — smoke list:
- token auth sanity
- simple generate call latency < 200ms p95 (for minimal prompt)
- embeddings sanity with small corpus
- billing header present

curl example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-2","prompt":"hi","max_tokens":16}'
```
sara_lewis: Docs + changelog updated. Push went to staging, SDK package built: pip redwood==22.0.0 and npm @redwood/sdk@22.0.0
evan: Noting breaking change: default timeout decreased to 30s. Add note to client comms and upgrade guide.
mike_chen: Good call. priy_r can you add a snippet to migration guide showing how to set timeout back? E.g.
```py
from redwood import Client
c = Client(timeout=60)
```
priya_r: On it. Also suggest feature-flag header for canary: X-Redwood-Release: v22-canary
jordan_ops: I'll set up canary buckets + alerting in Datadog: latency, error-rate, 5xx count, and token-cost delta.
deploy-bot: Deployment started for us-west canary at 2026-03-18T21:00:00Z
priya_r: us-west canary up. smoke tests passing: generate latency p95 180ms, embeddings ok. No 5xx. :tada:
mike_chen: Start 10% roll now in us-west; monitor for 30m. Priya/Jordan please ack once stable.
jordan_ops: 10% roll ack. Setting alert thresholds: 2x baseline p95 or +0.5% error-rate.
sara_lewis: Sent client comms draft to #marketing for review. Also posting upgrade note in console banner for 72h.
evan: One more note — ensure SDK retains old endpoints for backward compat for 30 days; fallback header should be accepted.
mike_chen: If anything looks off, rollback plan:
- immediate: flip canary header off and route to v21 (config change)
- if need full rollback: revert routing config and redeploy old package to s3 (artifact v21)
- notify support + customers list, open incident channel
priya_r: Confirmed artifact v21 available and tested. I can trigger rollback.
mike_chen: Thanks. Last check: docs, changelog, client comms, alerting, owners set. Anything else?
sara_lewis: Could we add a small telemetry flag to track migration rate? low overhead.
mike_chen: Add header X-Redwood-Migrate: v22 to clients who opt-in; will be in SDK by default for canary only.
evan: LGTM from platform side.
jordan_ops: Watching dashboards. will call rollback if alert fires.
mike_chen: ok cutting over to us-east in 2 hours. Thanks all. :rocket:
